title: fix(ui): Setup opens each email template locale as its own member
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ89oiN73SssvvwL4crhXoM3j)_
Fixes #26649

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 的元数据列表给邮件模板加了「语言」列,每一行链接带上自己的 `?member=语言`;编辑页把这个 member 传给读取(分层视图、草稿)和写入(发布、重置、放弃草稿)。
- 为什么改:同一模板的两种语言各占一行,但点哪一行都打开同一种语言,第二种语言在 Setup 里打不开也改不了(裁决 6444406836 选 A,服务端 `/layers?member=` 已由 #26861 落地)。
- 风险与回滚:只影响声明了 member 字段的类型(目前只有 `email_template`);其它类型的链接和请求逐字节不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ResourceEditPage.tsx`(读写都带 member,尤其重置/发布那几处)、`ResourceListPage.tsx`(行链接与语言列)、`metadata-client.ts`(五个方法的 `member` 参数)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.bundleMember-26649.test.tsx`,预期 5 个用例全绿;或在 Setup → Email Template 里点 zh-CN 那一行,地址栏带 `member=zh-CN`,打开的是中文内容。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Registry** (`registry.ts`, `default-schemas.ts`): a resource config may declare `bundleMemberField`, the body field that tells two members of one name apart; `email_template` declares `locale`. `BUNDLE_MEMBER_PARAM` (`member`) and `bundleMemberOf` live beside it. The server serves no bundle member key: its table (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`) lives in `@objectstack/metadata-core`, which no ui package depends on, and a `GET /meta/email_template` row carries only the body's own `locale`. So the field is declared UI-side, on the registry entry.
- **List** (`ResourceListPage.tsx`): for such a type, a Locale column sits second (label from `engine.list.col.locale`, en + zh rows in `i18n.ts`), and each row links `./NAME` plus the existing suffix (`?scope=environment` / `?package=`) plus `member=LOCALE`. A row with no locale (the canonical member) links by name alone, as before. Every other type's columns and links are unchanged.
- **Editor** (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`): `?member=` is read once and passed to the load's layered and draft reads (ruling 6444406836), and to the post-save, post-publish, post-reset and post-discard re-reads. It is also passed to the page's by-name writes, `publish`, `reset` and the draft discard: each of those doors addresses the canonical member when named none, so without it Reset on the `zh-CN` page would remove the `en-US` overlay and Publish would promote the `en-US` draft. The save sends no member (it is addressed by its body's `locale`). `readDraftForSave` gains an optional `member`.
- **Client** (`metadata-client.ts`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, patch changeset): `layered`, `get`, `getDraft`, `publish` and `reset` take an optional `member`, sent as `?member=` beside `?package=`, omitted (never empty) when absent. `getDraft` with a member skips the draft read when the ledger lists that name only as another member's draft.

## Tests

- `metadata-client.bundleMember-26649.test.ts` (8): each method sends `?member=`, beside `?package=`; no member means no parameter on every door; the ledger skip and its control.
- `ResourceListPage.bundleMember-26649.test.tsx` (4): two members of one template are two rows whose links differ by `member` and keep `scope=environment`; the canonical row links by name; the Locale column with each row's value; CONTROL: `page` (no members, body carrying `locale`) gets no column and no `member`.
- `ResourceEditPage.bundleMember-26649.test.tsx` (5): the real page over a real `MetadataClient` and an in-memory server keyed by `(name, member)`. Opening `?member=zh-CN` reads that member's layers and draft and shows its body; CONTROL with no `member` sends no selector; Publish, Discard draft and Reset each send `member=zh-CN` and change only the `zh-CN` rows.

Ablation, once: the load's layered read without `member` (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `64744a88` to `55c8f52b`) turns 2 of the 5 editor tests red ("reads the member's layers and draft…", "Reset removes the opened member's overlay…": `expected null to be 'zh-CN'`); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt whose replacement text already occurred in the file was refused by the tool before any test ran.

## Acceptance notes

- The server serves no bundle member key for a type (list rows, `/meta/types`), so the ui declares `email_template`'s field itself. A served key would let this registry row go.
- Changing the `locale` field of an existing template in the editor and saving writes another member (the save is body-addressed); the page keeps addressing the member in its URL. The create form asks for no locale, so a create lands on whatever the body defaults to.
- The history page and the references sheet send no member: history is out of this card's ruling, and references have no member concept.
